calls.title: Statsig Campaign Kick-Off
calls.summary: The team discussed launching an aggressive campaign to target key accounts in order to exploit Statsig's current weaknesses before Amplitude's product roadmap stabilizes. Ryan McGurk stressed the urgency of capturing market share, while the campaign focuses on positive differentiation, showcasing their robust roadmap, engineering talent, and customer success. Lindsay Berens prepared essential assets for outreach, and sales reps will handle prioritized accounts for focused efforts. Using updated behavioral data as of August 11, the team structured account prioritization and consolidated insights to ensure effective targeting. Marketing materials, including landing pages and content projects, were developed to address concerns over Statsig's future stability. A three-month free usage offer for new customers was considered tactically, and a structured email outreach strategy was discussed. The execution plan involves immediate account assignments, allowing for early engagement and iterative improvements.

calls.title: Statsig Campaign Kick-Off
calls.summary: The team launched an aggressive campaign aimed at Statsig customers, emphasizing the strengths of their product, including superior roadmaps and customer support. Lindsay Berens provided coordinated content, including landing pages and ads, to effectively position their offering. The sales team has access to a prioritized account list enriched with activity signals, allowing for focused outreach with 5 to 10 high-priority accounts per rep. Tailored messaging sequences were developed, highlighting the instability of Statsig's product transition to Amplitude. Ads are set to launch by August 26, emphasizing dependability and restricting the three-month free trial offer to private negotiations. The team emphasized quick execution and continuous feedback to refine the campaign.
